name: Michael Weigand
biography: has been breaking things and causing trouble since childhood... So he decided to make a career of it! He is currently studying computer science and military art at the United States Military Academy (West Point), with the goal of becoming an Army officer. He spends most of his free time racing sailboats, flying UAVs over officer housing, listening to trance, and working on crazy homebrews he thinks are applicable to the military.
